messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@auroramed.com>; Maya Singh <maya.singh@auroramed.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai; aditya.rao@redwood.ai; procurement@auroramed.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call exec recap: AuroraMed — leadership summary & procurement path

Hi Aaron / Maya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Wanted to capture the executive-level recap and make the next steps explicit so we can keep momentum with procurement and your leadership team.

Summary of pain points discussed:
- Latency spikes on interactive clinical summarization calls (p95 often > 500ms) that impact physician workflow adoption.
- High and unpredictable token spend from current vendor, especially for high-volume note generation.
- Data residency and auditability requirements for PHI: need SOC 2 + KMS/HSM support and region controls.

Business goals / success metrics you shared:
- Reduce per-session latency to p95 < 200ms for short notes (<= 512 tokens).
- Reduce per-token inference cost by ~30-40% overall through batching/caching/quantization.
- Pilot with 5 clinics in Q3, enterprise rollout in Q4 if pilot meets SLA & quality targets.

Procurement path and timeline (as we understand it):
- You (Aaron) will present the technical/clinical pilot ask to the CTO and COO by next week.
- Maya will coordinate with procurement for legal and PO requirements; procurement requested an SOW + pricing sheet and SOC 2 evidence.
- Target for signed SOW: early May 2027 (contingent on pilot results and exec approval).

Key risks / escalation items:
- SOC 2 audit evidence: we can provide our report and a KMS integration plan. Internal security engineering may need to do a short workshop with AuroraMed security team.
- Data residency: if AuroraMed requires on-prem or VPC-only deployment, that may push timeline; we discussed Dedicated or Private options.

Action items / next steps:
1) Redwood: Draft SOW + high-level pricing (attached draft pricing sheet) — deliver by Fri 3/26. (Attachment: AuroraMed_MAAP_quoting.pdf)
2) Redwood: Prepare SOC 2 evidence bundle and schedule a 60-minute security workshop with your security/IT leads week of 3/29.
3) AuroraMed: Aaron to brief CTO/COO; Maya to introduce procurement contact and confirm PO timeline.
4) Joint: Executive sponsor workshop (30-45 mins) to align on business outcomes — propose Tues 3/30 or Wed 3/31.

Attachments: AuroraMed_MAAP_quoting.pdf (pricing sheet), SOW-draft-v1.docx (we'll circulate a first pass SOW by EOD 3/26).

If I've missed anything or misstated a priority, please flag and I'll update. Happy to sync quick tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Internal note —

This looks good. Quick suggestions before we send the SOW:
- Add explicit per-environment latency targets (outpatient: p95 < 200ms; ED: p95 < 300ms) and define measurement window.
- Include a pilot success criteria checklist (NPS from physicians, error rate on hallucinations, latency SLOs, cost delta).
- Recommend we propose a 90-day pilot with an opt-in extension; include a pilot cap on total tokens to limit initial spend risk.

I'll draft the SOW pricing appendix with two pricing options (Hosted API with reserved throughput vs Dedicated pool) and send by EOD 3/26. Aditya — can you confirm our SOC 2 bundle availability and proposed security workshop times?
